about: Spec 3 of 04 SYSTEM SPECS: every one of the 61 kinds of bill part in the 220-measure enacted sample (data/research/bill-samples, measured in docs/research/bill-parts-catalog.md) mapped to one of the six levers of the decision register (Sept. 26), the record it changes, the fiscal-note formula, and whether an enacted-law writer reads it on main. A missing fiscal-note input uses its documented ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE basis and comparison places, never zero. Compliance and enforcement cost sizes are provisional game values.

levers.money: An account: appropriation, then payment and delivered service as separate records. The spending costs its amount.
levers.rate: The tax record (spec 2), the minimum wage (spec 1), a fee or a price cap. A tax raises rate times base; a wage floor costs employers (floor minus pay) times the hours of everyone below it.
levers.who-qualifies: A program's rules, so enrollment and benefit payments change. Enrollment change times benefit.
levers.rule: A rule record with its penalty and enforcer; violations recorded when a covered actor breaches. Enforcement cost plus compliance cost for whoever is covered.
levers.structure: The government's structure: new offices get seats and staff; preemption voids local rules. The new body's cost, or the savings from abolishing one.
levers.process: Due dates on the clock: reports come due, sunsets end rules, triggers switch changes on. Usually a small administrative cost.

effectWriterStatus.partial: a writer reads this part for some variants or places only
effectWriterStatus.none: no enacted-law writer reads it; the law's page says nothing acts on this part yet

missingVariantKinds.kind: tax changes beyond one flat rate
state override of local government, and local options
price caps and wage floors on private parties

parts.recordItChanges: A program or agency account: the appropriation, then obligation, payment and delivered service as separate records
parts.fiscalNote: The amount appropriated, spread over its availability period
parts.effectWriterToday: Appropriations only: governing/program-governing.ts appropriationFromEnactedMeasure reads amount-provided and records the appropriation; the 50 states only, not D.C. or the territories

parts.recordItChanges: The account or revenue the spending draws from, and that source's balance
parts.fiscalNote: No new cost; moves the named amount from the source to the program

parts.recordItChanges: The date after which unspent budget authority lapses
parts.fiscalNote: None by itself; unspent money past the date returns to the fund
parts.effectWriterToday: Appropriations only: the availability and lapse clauses set the spending window (governing/program-governing.ts)

parts.recordItChanges: The most a program may spend, a cap later appropriations must stay under
parts.fiscalNote: None until appropriated; the ceiling bounds later spending

parts.recordItChanges: A revenue stream tied to one account, so collections route there instead of the general fund
parts.fiscalNote: The earmarked revenue leaves the general fund for the named account

parts.recordItChanges: A grant account plus the awards, recipients and payments it makes
parts.fiscalNote: The grant pool, paid out as awards are made

parts.recordItChanges: Debt authority, then issued principal, interest and repayment schedule (spec 11)
parts.fiscalNote: Debt service: principal plus interest over the term; proceeds fund the named projects

parts.recordItChanges: A formula that splits one revenue among governments (state, counties, cities)
parts.fiscalNote: No net cost to the whole; each recipient gains or loses its formula share

parts.recordItChanges: A public loan account: principal lent, repayments and defaults
parts.fiscalNote: Principal lent, less expected repayments

parts.recordItChanges: A one-time payment to each qualifying person or household
parts.fiscalNote: Qualifying count times the rebate

parts.recordItChanges: Cancels unspent budget authority on an existing appropriation
parts.fiscalNote: Savings equal to the amount rescinded

parts.recordItChanges: The share of a program's cost a lower government pays
parts.fiscalNote: Cost moves between levels: the share times the program cost

parts.recordItChanges: Local money a recipient must commit before funds are released
parts.fiscalNote: The match share times the grant, borne by the recipient

parts.recordItChanges: The tax record's rate (spec 2), a wage rate (spec 1), a fee schedule or a price
parts.fiscalNote: A tax raises rate times base; a wage floor costs employers (floor minus pay) times the hours of everyone below it
parts.effectWriterToday: One flat rate on one base: tax-policy.ts adoptEnactedTaxPolicy reads the tax-levy part (Alaska is the only place with compiled tax powers)

parts.recordItChanges: An upper limit on a price, rent, charge or benefit, applied to private parties or a program
parts.fiscalNote: Savings to those capped: (charged price minus cap) times the units above it; a benefit cap saves (benefit minus cap) times recipients

parts.recordItChanges: A tax credit on the tax record, with its eligibility
parts.fiscalNote: Claimants times the credit, as lost revenue

parts.recordItChanges: A fee schedule: amount per permit, service or transaction
parts.fiscalNote: Fee times the count of transactions

parts.recordItChanges: What a tax applies to (spec 2): items added to or removed from the base
parts.fiscalNote: The rate times the base added or removed

parts.recordItChanges: A number that moves with an index each year (rates, brackets, wage floors, benefits)
parts.fiscalNote: The yearly change in the indexed number times what it applies to

parts.recordItChanges: A deduction from taxable income on the tax record
parts.fiscalNote: The deducted amount times the marginal rate of those who claim it

parts.recordItChanges: Income or value not counted by a tax
parts.fiscalNote: The excluded amount times the rate

parts.recordItChanges: An add-on percentage or amount on an existing charge
parts.fiscalNote: Surcharge rate times the charged base

parts.recordItChanges: Who or what a rule or program reaches
parts.fiscalNote: Change in covered count times the per-person cost or compliance cost

parts.recordItChanges: Who is left out of a rule, tax or program
parts.fiscalNote: Exempted count times the per-person tax, cost or benefit forgone
parts.effectWriterToday: Tax exempt bases only, through the same tax-levy route (tax-types.ts)

parts.recordItChanges: What each enrollee receives, so benefit payments change
parts.fiscalNote: Enrollees times the change in benefit

parts.recordItChanges: A program's qualification test, so enrollment changes
parts.fiscalNote: Change in enrollment times the benefit

parts.recordItChanges: The term a rule turns on, so who or what is covered changes
parts.fiscalNote: As covered-population: the change in covered count times its per-person effect

parts.recordItChanges: A number that decides coverage (income, employees, grams)
parts.fiscalNote: Change in count crossing the threshold times the per-person effect

parts.recordItChanges: Hours of work or activity an enrollee must report to keep a benefit
parts.fiscalNote: Enrollees dropped for not meeting it times the benefit, as savings; plus verification cost

parts.recordItChanges: Existing holders kept under the old rule
parts.fiscalNote: The protected count times the effect the new rule would have had on them

parts.recordItChanges: A rule record forbidding an act, with its penalty and enforcer; violations recorded when a covered actor breaches
parts.fiscalNote: Enforcement cost plus compliance cost for whoever is covered

parts.recordItChanges: A rule record requiring a named party to act, with a due date
parts.fiscalNote: Compliance cost for whoever is covered plus enforcement cost

parts.recordItChanges: Which agency enforces, and how; the agency bears enforcement cost
parts.fiscalNote: Enforcement cost to the named agency

parts.recordItChanges: The punishment attached to a rule: fine, jail or loss of license, applied on a recorded violation
parts.fiscalNote: Fines collected minus enforcement and custody cost

parts.recordItChanges: A measurable rule to meet (height limit, reserve ratio), checked against covered actors
parts.fiscalNote: Compliance cost plus enforcement cost

parts.recordItChanges: Information a covered party must publish, recorded when filed
parts.fiscalNote: Compliance cost for filers

parts.recordItChanges: A permission record a covered actor must hold before acting
parts.fiscalNote: Licensing cost to the agency, offset by license fees

parts.recordItChanges: Lets injured people or states sue; lawsuits become enforcement events
parts.fiscalNote: Court cost plus damages paid by violators

parts.recordItChanges: A route to challenge a decision, recorded as appeals and outcomes
parts.fiscalNote: Hearing cost per appeal

parts.recordItChanges: Advance warning a party must give (a rent increase, a layoff)
parts.fiscalNote: Small compliance cost

parts.recordItChanges: Which office runs the program; its staff and duties
parts.fiscalNote: The agency's added staff and operating cost
parts.effectWriterToday: Transit only: the pinned transit variant's administrative mandate (transit-funding.ts), Alaska only

parts.recordItChanges: A new or empowered board, with seats and staff
parts.fiscalNote: The board's cost: seats, staff and operations

parts.recordItChanges: A higher government voids or bars a lower government's rules on a subject
parts.fiscalNote: Lost local revenue, if the voided rule was a tax or fee; otherwise small

parts.recordItChanges: Power handed to an agency or official to act by rule
parts.fiscalNote: Administrative cost of the delegated work

parts.recordItChanges: A lower government may adopt the rule or tax itself
parts.fiscalNote: None until a locality adopts it; then as that rate or rule

parts.recordItChanges: Who names an office or board's members
parts.fiscalNote: None or small

parts.recordItChanges: When each section starts, on the shared clock
parts.fiscalNote: None by itself; shifts every other effect's timing
parts.effectWriterToday: Transit's own effective-date part, the appropriation's operative date, and a 90-day default for an enacted tax (tax-policy.ts); no per-section dates

parts.recordItChanges: Removes an existing provision; it changes the record the repealed provision had changed
parts.fiscalNote: The repealed provision's effect, reversed

parts.recordItChanges: A change arriving in dated steps
parts.fiscalNote: Each step's effect on its own date

parts.recordItChanges: A built-in end date after which the rule or program stops
parts.fiscalNote: The program's cost stops after the date
parts.effectWriterToday: program-sunset terminate-on-date, read only against the transit authority (transit-funding.ts)

parts.recordItChanges: How old rules hand over to new, with a dated window
parts.fiscalNote: Small administrative cost

parts.recordItChanges: A condition checked on the clock that switches a change on
parts.fiscalNote: The switched change's effect, only once the condition is met

parts.recordItChanges: Permission to skip a rule for a named party or period (and line-item vetoes)
parts.fiscalNote: The waived rule's cost or revenue, forgone for its scope

parts.recordItChanges: Time allowed to comply, as a due date
parts.fiscalNote: Small administrative cost

parts.recordItChanges: A report that comes due to a named body on a date
parts.fiscalNote: Small administrative cost

parts.recordItChanges: Enactment over the executive's veto: the law's enactment route
parts.fiscalNote: None: a route of enactment, not a change

parts.recordItChanges: The change waits on a ballot question passing
parts.fiscalNote: None until voters approve; then the change's own effect

parts.recordItChanges: An agency must write rules by a date (spec 19)
parts.fiscalNote: Agency drafting cost; the rule's own effects come when it is adopted

parts.recordItChanges: Citizens may petition a new law onto the ballot; the law is suspended while the petition stands
parts.fiscalNote: None, or the suspended law's effect forgone

parts.recordItChanges: How long something may last (a permit, a term, a benefit)
parts.fiscalNote: The affected cost or benefit ends at the limit

parts.recordItChanges: A study due before action
parts.fiscalNote: The study's cost
